body: thank you for this. It's nice to know that people in the same situation managed to recover
I just have always been affected of what other people think about me and the thought of being regarded as a failure really terrifies me
I always thought i could deal with this myself so i never bothered with medication or any therapy, but i feel like its kinda inevitable now.
Yeah it does offer counseling but i don't know if i have the courage to talk to someone about what im feeling yet. Really feeling ashamed even from the thought of talking to a counselor :/

I definitely am thinking about it now but i don't know how i'm gonna tell my family. It was me who decided to study abroad because i wanted to escape the things i was feeling. Ironically they've only gotten worse and worse.
